citations.raw: Vin. Ab. Trial (B, 2), 10, cites 29 Ap. xxxvii. 19 (E. 2)
citations.note: year book cited through Vin. Ab. Trial (B. 2) 10, on trial by inspection of nonage; 29 Edw. III. 1866 prints '29 Ap. xxxvii.' as 1835-60 do; the 1824-31 editions print '29 Ass. 37', the Liber Assisarum, pl. 37, so page left out and the plea noted here. '19 (E. 2)' is Viner's further reference with no folio, not recorded. Confidence medium as in the 1843 and 1860 records, the reading of 'Ap.' being uncertain. No source for the year books.
